title: Current standards on which a drug utilization review must rest
rule_summary: The drug utilization review shall be based upon CURRENT standards, which MAY include the American Hospital Formulary Service Drug Information, the United States Pharmacopoeia Drug Information, the American Medical Association Drug Evaluations, Plumb's Veterinary Drug Handbook, and other peer-reviewed medical literature. The named works are permissive examples rather than a closed list, and the governing requirement is currency.
exam_relevance: Tests both that the list is open and that a superseded edition of a listed work fails the currency requirement.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Treating the four named works as an exhaustive list
Rejecting current peer-reviewed literature because it is not named
Accepting a superseded edition of a named compendium as a current standard
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official publication on 2026-08-20 during Batch 3 tranche B3-C authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
